limitation: Raw USD TVL is valuation-sensitive and same-day MVRV is not an independent factor.
method: HAC residualization of USD TVL growth plus same-day MVRV identity diagnostic
research_question: What remains after price-adjusting USD TVL growth, and how mechanical is same-day MVRV?
sample: Daily BTC/ETH liquidity and measurement panel through 2026-04-14
uncertainty: HAC coefficient intervals; MVRV panel is a descriptive measurement-mechanics diagnostic
